# Maria Blair — Glorious Goddess

> Maria Blair is a dating coach and mentor for women 35+. A former software engineer and biohacker, single mom, and Boca Raton local, she went on 60+ intentional dates after leaving a 17-year marriage and created the Intentional Dating Method. She helps women re-enter dating with clarity, feminine energy, and unshakable standards — without pretending to be someone they're not.

Maria works with women who are divorced, single after a long relationship, or quietly stuck — and who are ready to date on purpose. She offers a private 1:1 video consultation and an online course. Her approach is warm and direct: coaching and mentorship, not therapy.

## Work with Maria

- [1:1 Video Consultation — $97 (regular $147)](https://mariablair.com/consultations): A private 60-minute-style video call. You look at your situation together, set goals, and build a clear action plan. Best for the woman who wants direct answers now. Booked via Stripe.
- [The Intentional Dating Method course — founding price $247 (reg. $397), launching soon](https://mariablair.com/course): An online course teaching women 35+ how to navigate modern dating without losing themselves. Modules cover identity, dating apps, a magnetic profile, images, red flags and scams, and safety and strategy. Currently in waitlist mode — join to get early access and founding-member pricing.

## The Intentional Dating Method (the philosophy)

1. **Inner Readiness First** — self-worth and nervous-system work before the apps, so you show up powerful, not desperate.
2. **Feminine Energy on Dates** — stop auditioning and start receiving; observe and enjoy.
3. **Your Personal Dating System** — choose one platform, build an honest profile, set clear standards, stay safe, and know when to commit.
